basic_details.job_title: SGOU University Librarian Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: Sreenarayanaguru Open University (SGOU) has notified 1 vacancy for the University Librarian post on a contract basis for an initial tenure of one year. Applicants must hold a Master's Degree in Library Science / Information Science / Documentation Science with at least 55% marks, 5 years experience, and a Ph.D. degree, with the notified pay being Rs. 39,690. Eligible candidates must apply online, remit the registration fee, and submit the printed application with self-attested copies of all credentials by post. rows.details: Upper age limit – 50 years as on 01/01/2026 (with usual relaxation to SC/ST and OBC as per Government of Kerala Rules and UGC Norms)
General / OBC: Rs. 1000/-; SC / ST / PwBD: Rs. 500/-

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates must possess all of the following essential qualifications on the last date of receipt of applications: A Master's Degree in Library Science / Information Science / Documentation Science, with at least 55% marks or an equivalent grade in a point scale wherever the grading system is followed. At least five years as a Librarian at any level in a University / college Library, or 5 years of teaching as Assistant Professor / Associate Professor in Library Science, or 5 years' experience as a College / institution Librarian. Evidence of innovative library services, including integration of Information and Communication Technology (ICT) in the library. A Ph.D. degree in Library Science / Information Science / Documentation Science / Archives and Manuscript-keeping.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The position is full-time on a contract basis for an initial period of one year, extendable based on performance review and requirement of the University. content_sections.heading: How to Apply for SGOU University Librarian
content_sections.text: Apply online through the University recruitment portal at sgou.ac.in/ , fill in all particulars, and upload legible copies of the required documents. Remit the registration fee to Account No. 361401010035599, IFSC: UBIN0536148, Branch: Union Bank, Kollam -1 through online as instructed in the submission portal. Obtain a copy of the fee receipt and submit it along with the hard copy of the online application to the University. Send the printed application, signed, with self-attested copies of all credentials by post to: The Registrar, Sreenarayanaguru Open University, Kureepuzha, Kollam, Kerala, superscribing the envelope 'Application for the post of Librarian, Notification No.'

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Applications will be scrutinised against the UGC qualifications and conditions in the notification. The University may shortlist candidates by fixing criteria higher than the minimum, based on qualifications, experience and desirable credentials. Shortlisted candidates will be invited for a presentation on a vision plan for establishing a hybrid digital library at SGOU, followed by an interview before a Selection Committee constituted as per UGC norms and the SGOU Statutes. The decision of the University on selection shall be final.

faq.question: Q1. Is the SGOU University Librarian post permanent or on contract?
faq.answer: The appointment is purely temporary and on a contract basis for an initial period of one year, extendable based on performance review and requirement of the University.

faq.question: Q2. Who is eligible for age relaxation?
faq.answer: Upper age relaxation is available to SC/ST and OBC candidates as per Government of Kerala Rules and UGC Norms.

faq.question: Q3. How are candidates shortlisted for the interview?
faq.answer: The University scrutinises applications against UGC qualifications and may shortlist candidates by fixing criteria higher than the minimum based on qualifications, experience, and desirable credentials.

faq.question: Q4. What desirable qualifications are preferred for this position?
faq.answer: Preference is given to candidates with proven experience in library establishment, digital library experience, digitisation, library automation, e-resources management, open and distance learning, national networks, open access and copyright, accessible library services, emerging technologies, research and professional standing, quality and accreditation, or additional qualifications like UGC-NET/SET and IT/data management certification.

faq.question: Q5. What documents must be sent with the hard copy of the application?
faq.answer: Candidates must enclose self-attested copies of detailed Curriculum Vitae with a passport-size photograph, proof of age, degree certificates and mark lists (Graduation, Master's, Ph.D.), UGC-NET/SET certificate (if any), experience certificates, portfolio of work covering libraries and digital initiatives, list of publications with top five copies, community/non-creamy layer/PwBD certificate, No Objection Certificate from present employer (if in service), vision note (not exceeding 1,000 words), and a signed declaration.
